description: Reopen r-sort-3b-memo read-only. On MM by IX_TK (TK Text(255), one column), Seek with each of = >= > <= < and 12 keys longer than 255 units or ending in blanks (A255-blank, A255-3blanks, A256-blank, A254-blank-A, blank-A255, a256, A256, A257, A5000, blank300, A254B-x, C-A300), reading NoMatch and the current ID after each. Asks whether an over-length key is compared whole (trailing blanks removed, then encoded and shortened like a stored key), cut at 255 units, or refused, and whether a very long key is refused.
